e02.defect: Every particle is a monotonically-decreasing soft radial luminance bell — no hard silhouette, no rim, no internal structure — so the field reads as glowing cyan dots rather than discrete bubbles.

e07.defect: Every flake renders as a luminous orb — a flat overexposed white core surrounded by an oversized soft halo — instead of a soft, low-contrast snowflake; the halos are wide enough that neighbouring flakes fuse into connected bright blobs by t=4s.

e06.defect: Every Form particle is a ~2 px dot sitting on an ~8-10 px lattice, so the sheet reads as a grid of separated glowing beads (an LED curtain) rather than a continuous silk surface, and because Form's Shading is Off with Specular Amount 0 every particle emits the same flat colour, so the sheet also has no soft shadow and no travelling highlight.
